BiblicalUsage: Dimnah was a Levitical city in Zebulun, given to the Levites along with its pasture lands. The name means dunghill, a plain name for a town set apart for God's servants.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God provides a place for those who serve Him, even when the name of the place is nothing to boast about.
